title: senna hayesiana
intro: Senna hayesiana, commonly known as Tanner's Cassia or Tanner's Senna, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The plant offers several health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Senna hayesiana can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, that may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic activities.
